$comment: GENERATED — do not edit by hand.

mark.symmetry: exact five-fold: rho has period 2pi/5 in t while theta advances 4pi/5, so the curve maps onto itself under a 4pi/5 rotation
mark.lineage: absorbs the centre of AIML~dark.png, which has five outer lobes and five crossings. The layered blob around it is dropped — it was the generic part.
mark.interlacing: drawn as 60 ordered chunks, each a ground-coloured casing plus an ink core. Later chunks paint over earlier ones and a torus knot's crossings alternate along its parameter, so the over/under comes out right without hand-authoring it.
mark.twoSizes: 256 and 96, each drawn at its own stroke weight rather than scaled — the same rule the icon set states, that a scaled drawing reads heavier than a drawn one

animation.what: the mark draws itself along its own length on first paint, then holds
animation.derivation: 120ms is --motion-fast; 720ms is 2 x --motion-gesture; neither is a picked number
animation.twoOrderings: the 120 chunks are PAINTED in depth order, so cos(5t) keeps the over/under correct, and REVEALED in parameter order, so the curve grows along itself. The same chunks, sorted twice.
animation.whyInsideTheFile: an SVG loaded as cannot read the host's custom properties, so the durations are written out with their derivation. Declarative CSS animation does run inside an SVG image; script does not, which is why this is CSS and not JS.
animation.reducedMotion: guarded inside the SVG: the animation is dropped and stroke-dashoffset resolves to 0, so the finished knot is simply there. A one-shot time-based animation always reaches its last frame, which is why it may touch a paint property at all — see the timeline-vs-time-based rule in tokens.json.
animation.notAClock: it runs once on load and stops. Nothing here loops.

family.basis: one construction per topic, all computed, all monochrome, and each carrying the symmetry its own physics has rather than a symmetry imposed on it — mirror, four-fold, two-fold rotational, barycentre-balanced, twenty-fold

topics.construction: sum of Gaussians in polar form, mirrored about the vertical axis
r = |cos 2theta|, the angular part of a d orbital, with both nodal planes
two-level interaction diagram with tie lines
topics.symmetry: two-fold rotational — the antibonding level rises by as much as the bonding level falls

topics.construction: octahedral splitting, eg at +0.6 Delta-o and t2g at -0.4 Delta-o
topics.symmetry: balanced, not mirrored: 2(+0.6) + 3(-0.4) = 0, so the barycentre is conserved

topics.construction: chord diagram of i -> (2i mod 20) on twenty points

family.correction: The fourth topic is MOLECULAR ELECTRONIC STRUCTURE, not "atoms". Two atoms make a molecule; there is no such thing as atomistic spectroscopy, and the subject is the molecule and its electronic structure. An earlier study set said "atoms" and offered Bohr shells; both are withdrawn.

withdrawn.topic-molecular-*.svg: A homonuclear two-centre sigma/sigma* pair. Withdrawn: it is a diatomic, and the subject is the MIXING of ligand and transition-metal orbitals — covalency — which is an unequal interaction, not a symmetric diatomic bond.
withdrawn.Bohr shells: Withdrawn with the "atoms" framing. Two atoms make a molecule; there is no atomistic spectroscopy, and the subject is the molecule and its electronic structure.

spectrum.status: SYNTHETIC, and labelled as such wherever it appears
spectrum.why: Real fitted peaks change with every run, and a synthetic curve presented as a measurement would be the unsourced claim this system refuses. A model with its parameters written down IS sourced — as a model.
spectrum.form: r(theta) = 0.34 + sum_i a_i * 0.42 * exp(-(theta - c_i)^2 / 2 w_i^2), theta in degrees, mirrored at 180
spectrum.toMakeItReal: replace PEAKS with fitted centres, widths and amplitudes from one SpectraFit run and record the run alongside them

sources: Ligand field theory — the covalency of ligand and transition-metal mixing
